mapper.select: SELECT id, name FROM region ORDER BY LENGTH(name) DESC, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchants ( region_id, name, taxpayer_identification_number, address, category, latitude, longitude, phone_number, rating, thumbnail_url, price ) VALUES ( #{regionId}, #{name}, NULL, #{address}, #{category}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{phoneNumber}, NULL, #{thumbnailUrl}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE merchants SET region_id = #{regionId}, name = #{name}, address = #{address}, category = #{category}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, phone_number = COALESCE(#{phoneNumber}, phone_number), thumbnail_url = COALESCE(#{thumbnailUrl}, thumbnail_url) WHERE id = #{merchantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tourism_merchant_sources ( merchant_id, content_id, modified_time, last_seen_sync_id, detail_modified_time, is_active ) VALUES ( #{merchantId}, #{contentId}, #{modifiedTime}, #{syncId}, #{detailModifiedTime}, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE merchant_id = VALUES(merchant_id), modified_time = VALUES(modified_time), last_seen_sync_id = COALESCE( VALUES(last_seen_sync_id), last_seen_sync_id), detail_modified_time = COALESCE( VALUES(detail_modified_time), detail_modified_time), is_active = 1

INSERT INTO activities (merchant_id, activity_type, description) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{activityType}, #{description}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE activity_type = VALUES(activity_type), description = COALESCE(VALUES(description), description)

INSERT INTO restaurants (merchant_id, food_type, price_level, description) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{foodType}, #{priceLevel}, #{description}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE food_type = VALUES(food_type), price_level = VALUES(price_level), description = COALESCE(VALUES(description), description)

INSERT INTO accommodations ( merchant_id, accommodation_type, description, check_in_time, check_out_time ) VALUES ( #{merchantId}, #{accommodationType}, #{description}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE accommodation_type = VALUES(accommodation_type), description = COALESCE(VALUES(description), description), check_in_time = COALESCE(VALUES(check_in_time), check_in_time), check_out_time = COALESCE(VALUES(check_out_time), check_out_time)
mapper.update: UPDATE tourism_merchant_sources SET is_active = 0 WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND is_active = 1

UPDATE tourism_merchant_sources tms INNER JOIN activities a ON a.merchant_id = tms.merchant_id SET tms.is_active = 0 WHERE a.activity_type = #{activityType} AND tms.is_active = 1 AND (tms.last_seen_sync_id IS NULL OR tms.last_seen_sync_id <> #{syncId})

UPDATE tourism_merchant_sources tms INNER JOIN merchants m ON m.id = tms.merchant_id SET tms.is_active = 0 WHERE m.category = #{placeType} AND tms.is_active = 1 AND (tms.last_seen_sync_id IS NULL OR tms.last_seen_sync_id <> #{syncId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tourism_sync_runs (mode, status, target_dates) VALUES (#{mode}, #{status}, #{targetDates})
mapper.update: UPDATE tourism_sync_runs SET status = #{status}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, deactivated_count = #{deactivatedCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: id, mode, status, target_dates, processed_count, deactivated_count, error_message, started_at, finished_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tourism_sync_runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
